title: Port candidates — what else our own donors are holding
summary: Zach asked, off the back of the focus slider: what else can we port from systemsketch / pyblocks that we haven't yet? Answer: 25 verified candidates ranked by the focus-slider test (mature, self-contained, already designed) — led by the mutation chain, ELK organize, the edge-drop quick menu, port affordances, and the at-risk System-boundary-ports feature, whose gestures exist only as untracked files.
branch_label: agent worktree off claude/bar-block-storybook-e61a36 (survey lane — no component code touched)
changes: docs/build_port_candidates_fragments.py — new: the fragment builder; every cited donor path is opened at build time and a missing one kills the build, so a citation cannot rot silently
docs/fragments/port-candidates-*.html — nine generated fragments (hero, landed ledger, at-risk inventory, top five, tier 2, tier 3, full table, ruled out, decision surface)
reports/media/port-candidates-2026-09-18.html — the report (written to the MAIN checkout's reports/media/, the durable location)
findings: 25 port candidates verified across 46 systemsketch top-level dirs, its lane worktrees, pyblocks, and the frozen packages/bbox-ui v1 — every donor path opened today, line counts measured at build time, never cited from memory

17 rows of docs/REMAINING-2026-09-17.md have LANDED since it was written (wire layer, scene record, lint+edge validation, availability preview, bubble, diagnostics paint, value preset, linking, sceneDiff+word/field/line diff, batchWire model, tunnels+layers, fitToContent, magnet, member dnd, drag policy, glyph-picker package, panel/inspector packages) — each with an evidence path checked to exist; that doc's axis was capability, this one's is donor code

AT RISK: ~2,600 lines of reviewed, screenshotted donor work exist in NO commit on any branch — vision-consolidated's four System gesture files (548 lines; its model is committed 13 unmerged commits deep on the lane branch) and the 1,261-line batch-wiring family + chrome, plus contextual-menu-next's menuComposition (710 lines incl. tests). One git stash -u from gone; measured live at build time

The single component gap gating four candidates (#1 effect ports, #5 boundary walls, #8 Loop/Branch bands, and REMAINING §3.2) is unchanged today: rails attach only to a Block's four outer walls — one decision (edgeT-style inset placement) unblocks the family

Already landed but easy to miss: the icon picker is packages/glyph-picker (ported by value from SystemSketch), and the inspector ENGINE is packages/panel — so donor iconPicker/ and BlockInspector are content ports at most, not feature ports

14 of 25 candidate rows carry the donor's own review screenshot (17 captures total, cropped + re-encoded WebP); 2 mechanisms are drawn SVG in the approved visual kit (kit map, pyblocks identity ladder); the remaining rows are one-sentence mechanisms that need no figure
